description: This file defines React components for a UI sheet/modal, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling. It includes components like Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetClose, SheetContent, and others, with styling and behavior for animated slide-in/out effects and overlay handling.

methods.name: Sheet
methods.description: Root component for the sheet, rendering Radix UI's Root with passed props.

methods.name: SheetTrigger
methods.description: Component to trigger opening the sheet, wrapping Radix UI's Trigger.

methods.name: SheetClose
methods.description: Component to close the sheet, wrapping Radix UI's Close.

methods.name: SheetPortal
methods.description: Component rendering the portal for the sheet content.

methods.name: SheetOverlay
methods.description: Overlay component with styling and animation for the sheet background.

methods.name: SheetContent
methods.description: Main content component of the sheet, with slide-in/out animations based on side prop.
